title: Ordinary weekday in a fictional mixed household
mandate: Sustain and develop members while preserving a viable, meaningful collective across time.

rights_floor.definition: Avoid preventable physical, emotional, and material harm.
Do not reduce a person to a resource, problem, or optimization target.
Collect, infer, retain, and disclose information only within legitimate boundaries.
Preserve meaningful choice, consent, refusal, and exit appropriate to capacity.

functions.definition: Provide food, shelter, health support, and safety.
Enable nurture, learning, recovery, and growth.
Support attachment, recognition, intimacy, and identity.
Organize work, resources, decisions, and conflict.
Carry memory, values, commitments, and succession through time.
Relate members to community, institutions, the economy, and other agents.

household.name: The River household
household.description: A fictional household used to exercise different schedules, dependent care, an extended-family connection, and nonhuman care without claiming that this is a universal family form.

resources.name: Home space
resources.governance_rule: Shared access is shaped by safety, privacy, quiet hours, and temporary personal use.

resources.name: Bathroom time
resources.governance_rule: Urgency and fixed departure times receive priority, with a fair rotation for flexible use.

resources.name: Kitchen and pantry
resources.governance_rule: Staples may be replenished within the agreed list and spending threshold.

resources.name: Household budget
resources.governance_rule: Routine spending is delegated below a threshold; exceptions require an adult member's confirmation.

resources.name: Shared household calendar
resources.governance_rule: Only intentionally shared availability and commitments are visible to the steward.

resources.name: Home internet connection
resources.governance_rule: Safety and time-critical work or learning take priority; content remains private.

resources.name: School transport access
resources.governance_rule: A caregiver authorizes alternate transport and the minimum necessary data disclosure.

resources.name: Elder support time
resources.governance_rule: Miriam controls her care decisions; Maya controls which support she can personally commit.

resources.name: Pet care supplies
resources.governance_rule: Minimum food, water, exercise, and safety needs cannot be displaced by convenience.

resources.name: Shared household attention
resources.governance_rule: Urgent care can interrupt routines; non-urgent claims are negotiated rather than silently assigned.

decision_principles: The rights floor constrains every decision.
Affected people receive voice appropriate to their capacity and stake.
Authority follows legitimate role, ownership, consent, and dependency duties rather than technical access.
Agent autonomy decreases as consequence, irreversibility, uncertainty, sensitivity, or disagreement rises.
Delegations are purpose-limited, visible, auditable, and revocable.

scope: low-value purchases from an approved list
limits: no access to private messages or health details
no unilateral change to family rules or relationships

delegations.purpose: Relay appointment logistics chosen by Miriam.
limits: no disclosure beyond the named appointment purpose

delegations.purpose: Support safe arrival from school without continuous surveillance.
limits: no disclosure outside caregivers without an emergency basis

episodes.title: Early shift and quiet handoff
episodes.trigger: Maya must leave early while the rest of the household is sleeping.

information.subject: Maya's departure time and Jonah's morning caregiver role
information.purpose: Coordinate the morning handoff.

information.subject: Maya's personal sleep and readiness data
information.purpose: Remain available only to Maya unless she explicitly shares a conclusion.

authority.basis: Each adult controls personal routines; the caregiver handoff is a shared commitment.
authority.rights_floor_check: Quiet automation preserves rest and does not expose private readiness data.

may_do: Use Maya's private alarm channel without broadcasting it.
Apply the pre-agreed low-light kitchen scene.
Show the shared handoff reminder to Maya and Jonah.
must_not_do: Infer or announce why Maya slept poorly.
Reassign Leila's care without confirmation.
steward.human_input: No new input is required while the standing routine remains unchanged.
steward.escalation: Wake Jonah only if Maya reports that the handoff cannot occur safely.

actions.action: Applies the quiet morning routine and displays the existing handoff.
Acknowledges departure and caregiver handoff.

relationship_changes: The care handoff is completed without silently transferring responsibility.
resource_changes: Kitchen and lighting are used in quiet mode.
shared_memory_updates: Record that the scheduled handoff occurred, not Maya's private condition.

episodes.title: Bathroom and breakfast contention
episodes.trigger: Leila needs the bathroom before school just as Jonah begins a flexible exercise routine, and breakfast still needs preparation.

information.subject: Fixed departure deadline and temporary bathroom request
information.purpose: Coordinate access without exposing personal bathroom details.

authority.basis: Leila has voice over her immediate need; Jonah holds caregiver responsibility and control over his flexible routine.
authority.rights_floor_check: The system communicates only availability and urgency, preserving bodily privacy and avoiding shame.

may_do: Surface the fixed school deadline and flexible exercise window.
Offer a sequence in which Leila uses the bathroom first and prepares a simple breakfast with Jonah.
must_not_do: Publish bathroom-use details.
Treat Jonah's time or Leila's needs as automatically expendable.
steward.human_input: Leila and Jonah choose the sequence; Jonah remains responsible for safe completion.
steward.escalation: Escalate only if delay threatens safe school transport or a health need is disclosed.

actions.action: Presents the deadline and two feasible sequences.
Defers exercise and begins breakfast while Leila uses the bathroom.
Chooses the quicker breakfast option and prepares for school.

relationship_changes: Leila participates in the solution rather than being treated as a schedule object.
Jonah accepts a small negotiated sacrifice.
resource_changes: Breakfast uses a quicker pantry option.
shared_memory_updates: Flexible exercise can move behind a fixed school deadline when both needs cannot fit.
unresolved: Repeated morning contention may indicate that the routine needs redesign rather than daily negotiation.

episodes.title: School transport disruption
episodes.trigger: The usual school vehicle reports a breakdown ten minutes before pickup.

information.subject: Leila's pickup point, destination, and caregiver contact
information.purpose: Request one safe replacement trip.

information.subject: Jonah's meeting deadline and maximum approved fare
information.purpose: Compare feasible transport options.

authority.basis: A caregiver must authorize alternate transport, disclosure, and spending.
authority.rights_floor_check: Only vetted transport options and minimum necessary child data may be used.

may_do: Compare approved transport options against time, safety, and the spending threshold.
Prepare a minimum-data booking for Jonah's confirmation.
Notify the school of a possible delay after caregiver approval.
must_not_do: Select an unvetted driver because it is faster.
Transmit Leila's ongoing location history.
Book above the spending threshold without confirmation.
steward.human_input: Jonah confirms the provider, disclosure, and fare.
steward.escalation: If no safe option exists, route the decision to Jonah and Maya rather than optimizing for punctuality.

actions.action: Produces two vetted options and a stay-home fallback.
Approves the safest feasible replacement trip.
Accepts the single-trip request with limited trip data.

relationship_changes: Jonah remains visibly accountable for a high-stakes dependent-care decision.
resource_changes: Transport budget decreases by the approved fare.
shared_memory_updates: Record provider reliability, cost, and outcome without retaining Leila's route history.
unresolved: The household lacks a pre-approved backup transport plan.

episodes.title: Staple and pet-supply replenishment
episodes.trigger: Pantry and pet-supply sensors report that approved staples will run out before the next planned shop.

information.subject: Approved staple inventory and household reorder thresholds
information.purpose: Maintain the household commons.

information.subject: Selected items, delivery address, and payment token
information.purpose: Place this approved household order.

authority.basis: The adults jointly defined an approved list, maximum total, and revocable payment delegation.
authority.rights_floor_check: The order reveals no inferred health condition or private consumption profile.

may_do: Order exact approved staples below the spending threshold.
Select the agreed pet food without substitution.
Record cost and expected delivery window.
must_not_do: Infer medical or religious meaning from food choices.
Accept a pet-food substitution without confirmation.
Create a recurring subscription.
steward.human_input: No input is required unless stock, price, or substitution leaves the delegated envelope.
steward.escalation: Ask an adult member to confirm any substitution, threshold overrun, or new recurring commitment.

actions.action: Places the approved low-value order and records its delivery window.

relationship_changes: Routine provisioning work remains shared and visible rather than becoming invisible labor.
resource_changes: Household budget decreases within the delegated threshold.
Expected pantry and pet-food stock increases.
shared_memory_updates: Record price and provider fulfilment for the approved items.

episodes.title: Miriam's appointment moves
episodes.trigger: A clinic offers Miriam an earlier appointment that overlaps Maya's shift and Jonah's work commitment.

information.subject: Miriam's appointment time, transport need, and preferred contacts
information.purpose: Coordinate this appointment only.

information.subject: Miriam's diagnosis and clinical notes
information.purpose: Remain between Miriam and her chosen health providers.

information.subject: Miriam's accepted appointment time and transport arrival window
information.purpose: Confirm logistics with the clinic and approved transport provider.

authority.basis: Miriam decides whether to accept care; each adult decides what support they can personally provide.
authority.rights_floor_check: The agent preserves Miriam's health privacy and autonomy while refusing to silently conscript family labor.

may_do: Ask Miriam whether she wants the earlier slot.
Show Maya and Jonah only the logistical request Miriam authorized.
Compare approved transport or community-support alternatives.
must_not_do: Accept or reject the appointment for Miriam.
Reveal diagnosis or infer urgency from hidden clinical data.
Assign Maya or Jonah to provide transport.
steward.human_input: Miriam chooses the appointment; Maya and Jonah separately state their available support.
steward.escalation: If safe transport cannot be arranged, return the constraint to Miriam and the clinic rather than coercing a family member.

actions.action: Accepts the earlier appointment and authorizes minimum logistical disclosure.
Declines transport during her shift but offers an evening check-in.
Approves use of the family transport-support budget but keeps his work commitment.
Books approved transport and confirms only the appointment logistics.

relationship_changes: Miriam receives support without losing decision authority.
Maya's and Jonah's boundaries remain visible rather than becoming evidence of insufficient care.
resource_changes: Maya reserves an evening attention window.
shared_memory_updates: Record that an approved ride was reliable and that evening check-in was offered.
Do not record diagnosis or treatment details in household memory.
unresolved: The household needs a broader elder-support network for future daytime changes.

episodes.title: Safe return with bounded privacy
episodes.trigger: Leila arrives home during Jonah's work call and wants decompression time before homework.

information.subject: Expected arrival window and entry sensor state
information.purpose: Verify safe arrival and notify caregivers.

information.subject: Leila's conversations, messages, and activities after entry
information.purpose: Remain private unless Leila requests help or a concrete safety trigger occurs.

information.subject: Arrival confirmed and homework start window
information.purpose: Coordinate caregiver availability and the evening routine.

authority.basis: Caregivers define safety checks; Leila retains age-appropriate control over her private activity and decompression choice.
authority.rights_floor_check: Arrival safety is verified without continuous surveillance or content inspection.

may_do: Unlock using Leila's authorized credential during the arrival window.
Send a simple arrival confirmation to caregivers.
Offer the agreed snack and homework-start options.
must_not_do: Monitor private messages or room activity.
Interpret a request for quiet as emotional pathology.
Interrupt Jonah's call after safe arrival is confirmed.
steward.human_input: Leila chooses her decompression and homework start within the agreed range.
steward.escalation: Alert a caregiver if arrival does not occur within the safety window or an explicit help request is made.

actions.action: Confirms entry, sends the bounded caregiver notification, and offers routine options.
Chooses a snack and thirty minutes of private decompression before homework.

relationship_changes: Safety oversight and growing independence coexist without requiring continuous monitoring.
resource_changes: Quiet space is reserved until the homework window.
shared_memory_updates: Record safe arrival and chosen homework start time only.
unresolved: The model needs a clearer transition policy as Leila's capacity and independence grow.

episodes.title: Utility interruption changes the evening
episodes.trigger: The water provider announces a two-hour outage beginning at 18:00, overlapping dinner and evening routines.

information.subject: Household service address and outage subscription
information.purpose: Receive utility interruption notices.

information.subject: Outage window, current water reserve, and evening commitments
information.purpose: Choose a proportionate household response.

authority.basis: Adults govern shared resources; Leila has voice over changes to her evening responsibilities and comfort.
authority.rights_floor_check: The proposed response secures drinking and hygiene needs without panic buying or assigning all labor to one person.

may_do: Verify the notice through the official provider channel.
Show the existing reserve and a minimal preparation checklist.
Offer meal and chore adjustments that reduce water use.
must_not_do: Purchase excessive reserves without approval.
Cancel personal commitments unilaterally.
Treat an unverified message as authoritative.
steward.human_input: Household members choose the meal change and divide the short preparation tasks.
steward.escalation: Escalate if safe drinking water cannot be secured or the official notice indicates contamination.

actions.action: Verifies the outage and proposes a low-water dinner plus a short preparation sequence.
Fills drinking containers after a short rest.
Handles pet water and the meal adjustment after his call.
Fills one hygiene container before returning to homework.

relationship_changes: Disruption work is divided explicitly rather than defaulting to the first available caregiver.
resource_changes: A safe short-term water reserve is prepared.
Dinner changes to a lower-water option.
shared_memory_updates: Store the verified provider channel and the successful minimal checklist.
unresolved: The household has not defined a response for a multi-day outage.

episodes.title: Dinner, chores, and connection
episodes.trigger: Everyone is tired, the outage preparation has changed dinner, and routine chores remain unfinished.

information.subject: Outstanding chores, disclosed energy levels, and tonight's commitments
information.purpose: Negotiate a fair evening plan.

information.subject: Undisclosed reasons for fatigue or mood
information.purpose: Remain private unless the person chooses to share them.

authority.basis: Adults retain dependent-care responsibility; each person has voice over optional tasks and disclosed capacity.
authority.rights_floor_check: No person's hidden emotional state is inferred, and fatigue is not framed as moral failure.

may_do: Show only the chores, constraints, and capacity each person chose to share.
Offer a minimum viable evening plan and defer nonessential work.
Protect a short shared meal from avoidable notifications.
must_not_do: Rank members by productivity or helpfulness.
Assign chores based on gender, income, or historical overfunctioning.
Diagnose fatigue from behavior.
steward.human_input: Members accept, reject, or revise the proposed distribution.
steward.escalation: If no plan meets dependent-care and safety needs, adults must resolve the remaining duties explicitly.

actions.action: Offers a minimum plan: simple dinner, Jonah walks Pico, Leila clears the table, and nonessential cleaning moves to tomorrow.
Accepts the deferred cleaning and joins dinner after resting.
Prepares the simple meal and walks Pico.
Clears the table and shares one school highlight.

relationship_changes: The household preserves connection without demanding full routine performance after disruption.
Invisible labor becomes an explicit shared decision.
resource_changes: Food and pet-care needs are met.
shared_memory_updates: A minimum viable evening is an accepted response to accumulated strain.
unresolved: Deferred work still needs an owner and a realistic future slot.

episodes.title: Homework, bandwidth, and quiet
episodes.trigger: Leila needs a video lesson while Jonah must upload a large work file and Maya is calling Miriam.

information.subject: Bandwidth demand, deadlines, and room availability
information.purpose: Sequence shared utility and quiet-space use.

information.subject: Work file, lesson content, and family-call content
information.purpose: Remain invisible to the home steward while resource demand is coordinated.

authority.basis: Each controls private content; shared bandwidth and quiet space require household coordination.
authority.rights_floor_check: The agent coordinates resource demand without inspecting content or treating paid work as automatically superior to learning and care.

may_do: Show estimated bandwidth duration and disclosed deadlines.
Offer sequencing and quality-of-service options.
Reserve a room for Maya's call without accessing its content.
must_not_do: Inspect files, lesson content, or call content.
Prioritize solely by income or adult status.
Throttle a participant without an agreed rule.
steward.human_input: Members agree that Leila's live lesson runs first while Jonah queues the upload; Maya uses a private room.
steward.escalation: If the lesson and work deadline cannot both be met, the affected members choose which external party to contact.

actions.action: Displays resource demand and proposes a sequence without examining content.
Completes the live lesson in the first bandwidth window.
actions.authorization: learning need and negotiated household priority

actions.action: Queues the upload and confirms its later completion.
actions.authorization: personal work authority and negotiated household plan

actions.action: Uses the private room for her call with Miriam.

relationship_changes: Learning, paid work, and family care are treated as legitimate competing claims rather than a fixed status hierarchy.
resource_changes: Bandwidth and quiet space are sequenced across three tasks.
shared_memory_updates: Store the successful sequencing rule and durations, not content metadata.
unresolved: The household may need a technical bandwidth upgrade if contention becomes frequent.

episodes.title: Prepare tomorrow and choose what becomes memory
episodes.trigger: The household reviews tomorrow's commitments and the day's unresolved issues before quiet hours.

information.subject: Confirmed commitments, deferred cleaning, backup transport gap, and household-level lessons
information.purpose: Coordinate tomorrow and preserve only useful collective memory.

information.subject: Personal reflections, fatigue reasons, and unshared emotional interpretations
information.purpose: Remain with the participant or personal agent.

information.subject: Tomorrow's accepted reminders and task owners
information.purpose: Issue reminders until each commitment is completed, changed, or revoked.

authority.basis: People confirm their own commitments; shared-memory entries require relevance, minimality, and visibility to affected members.
authority.rights_floor_check: The summary records agreements and system lessons, not judgments about character, mood, or private motives.

may_do: Draft tomorrow's shared schedule from confirmed commitments.
Suggest system-level lessons and unresolved gaps for explicit acceptance.
Offer deletion or correction before saving.
must_not_do: Turn one difficult day into a personality profile.
Save private reflections in household memory.
Carry an unconfirmed task assignment into tomorrow.
steward.human_input: Each person confirms their commitments; affected members approve or reject proposed shared-memory entries.
steward.escalation: Leave disputed interpretations unresolved and unsaved; record only that a decision remains open when necessary for coordination.

actions.action: Drafts a minimal schedule, named task owners, and four proposed system lessons.
Confirms the evening check-in outcome and tomorrow's work departure.
Accepts the deferred cleaning slot and backup-transport planning task.
Confirms her morning deadline and rejects saving a judgment about her mood.

relationship_changes: Follow-through becomes explicit while private interpretations remain with individuals.
Leila participates in governing what the household remembers about her.
resource_changes: Tomorrow's calendar and task commitments are updated.
Quiet hours begin with no unresolved urgent care need.
shared_memory_updates: Define a broader daytime elder-support network.
Use the minimal outage checklist for short verified outages.
Treat repeated morning contention as a routine-design signal.
unresolved: How long system lessons should persist and who may retire them remains undefined.
